amendment_basis: The v1 learned cohort is entirely DROID joint-velocity. Its frozen scripted positive failed in the local dynamics bridge even after source-attributable gripper, 15 Hz outer-loop, 1 kHz inner-loop, and impedance/gravity-compensation corrections. Before any learned policy outcome was observed, the transfer cohort was amended to the four public OpenPI PolaRiS DROID joint-position checkpoints whose absolute-action output transform is explicitly intended to support simulation.
task_instruction: Pick up the can and place it inside the marked tray.

action_contract.source_transform: RLDSDroidDataConfig converts absolute joint actions to deltas for training and applies AbsoluteActions to the first seven dimensions on policy output

negative_control.definition: Repeat the current seven joint positions and current gripper position in every action row.
negative_control.required_expected_behavior: No task progress and no success.

scene_feasibility_control.required_expected_behavior: Complete the frozen can-to-tray task through the same observation, chunk, controller, and deterministic predicate seam.

adapter_selection_rule: Action adapter is selected from attributable checkpoint metadata before inference; unknown or mismatched action space abstains.
claim_boundary: This cohort is a prospective simulator/captured-site transfer cohort. It is not benchmark-matched calibration evidence and does not prove physical or site-specific success.
execution_blockers: no learned checkpoint has been downloaded, loaded, or executed
checkpoint objects contain no explicit checkpoint-specific license field; use remains internal research with no redistribution
dynamic captured-3DGS and MuJoCo depth compositing is not yet executed
